verdict.rationale: Formant exposes Admin, Cloud SDK and query/ingestion APIs, so scoped API credentials are a fair question for this platform. However, the evidence never mentions API keys, service accounts, token scopes or role-limited credentials that could be issued to an agent. Device provisioning and re-provisioning of the on-robot 'Formant agent' is device identity management, not least-privilege API credentialing, so it earns no credit.
